title: 新中式饮品战争③：一天卖542万杯的咖啡 | China's Drink Wars P3 ☕
description:
你会点一杯「酱香拿铁」尝尝吗？评论区告诉我。

【新中式饮品战争·第3集】2023 年 9 月 4 日，瑞幸联名贵州茅台推出「酱香拿铁」——上市首日单品卖出 542 万杯，销售额一天破亿，直接刷新纪录。它把咖啡和 53%vol 的茅台酒风味厚奶调在一起，里面是真的加了茅台；但成品酒精度不到 0.5%，喝了不算沾酒。原价 38 元、用券约 19 元，一句「美酒加咖啡」瞬间刷屏全网。

On Sept 4, 2023, Luckin Coffee teamed up with liquor giant Moutai for the 'Moutai Latte' — and sold 5.42 million cups on day one, topping 100 million yuan in a single day. It blends coffee with a baijiu-flavored milk made from real 53% Moutai — yet the finished drink is under 0.5% alcohol. Priced at 38 yuan (about 19 with a coupon), 'wine meets coffee' instantly broke the Chinese internet.

AI-assisted edit; bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Neutral market observation, not investment advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
